title: DEA conformance certificate
description: The output of a conformance run. Deliberately carries NO score, grade or percentage: a percentage invites declaring requirements INAPPLICABLE to raise the denominator and shrinking the hypothesis set to make DEA-6 easier, both of which raise the number and lower what it means (DEA_PROFILE section 7). A reader who wants a summary reads the verdicts.

shares_code_with_csia.description: Recorded because a profile validated only against its own author's implementation is a description of that implementation. At least one conforming reference must have this false.

hypothesis_set_size.description: Conformance is relative to the declared hypothesis set. An implementation admitting two hypotheses conforms more easily than one admitting twenty, so certificates from different sets must not be compared.

witness.description: REQUIRED on FAIL. A failure without a witness is an opinion.

conformant.description: true only when FAIL is 0 AND INCONCLUSIVE is 0. An untested requirement is not a satisfied one.

caveats.description: What this certificate does not mean. At minimum: conformance is not correctness, not safety, and not certification.
